subject: Pipeline triage: discount approval blocking commit visibility for ClearWind Energy
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@clearwind.io>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearwind.io>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discount request — need expedited deal desk + finance review (ClearWind)

Team — looping you all in as this discount is the gating item for moving CW-9843 into commit for the Q4 forecast. Quick summary:
- Account: ClearWind Energy (strategic regional pilot)
- ARR/ACV: $720k first-year; expected ramp in year 2
- Requested concession: 28% on base list (bulk seat discount + first-year incentive) — exceeds standard SDR threshold
- Current HubSpot stage: Proposal Sent (best case). Sales asks to mark as "commit" once approvals are in place.

Attachments: ClearWind_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW with term table), discount_matrix_q3.csv (pricing calc).

As finance headcount is thin this week, can Deal Desk triage and confirm whether this 28% can be approved under delegated authority or if we need formal pricing committee review? If it needs committee, we need an ETA — ClearWind is pushing for a signed SOW by EOW to hit Q4 commit.

Action requested: Ben — can you evaluate and advise on the approval path + recommended counter if committee required? Vanessa — please flag any forecast effect if we cannot close by Friday. I will escalate to Markus if we need an SLA exception.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, GTM Finance
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: ClearWind_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf), discount_matrix_q3.csv (text/csv)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discount request — need expedited deal desk + finance review (ClearWind)

Laura — thanks for the context and attachments. Quick read and initial take:
- 28% sits above our standard delegated pricing for a deal of this size; Deal Desk can approve up to 20% with documented rationale. Anything >20% needs pricing committee + finance sign-off.
- Justification that will help speed: strategic pilot language, committed expansion milestones tied to ARR, and clear churn protections (shorter initial term with renewal at list pricing).

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik — please confirm whether sales can accept a staged discount (20% on year 1, the remaining 8% as a milestone rebate tied to usage/expansion). If yes, Deal Desk can approve today and we keep the commit.
2) If not acceptable to ClearWind, we escalate to Pricing Committee — earliest slot is Tuesday 21st; finance (Markus) will need to be on the approval thread.

Forecast impact: if we cannot mark this as commit by Friday, there is a risk the account slips to next quarter. Vanessa, what is the exposure to Q4 if we stall?

I will prep a short approval memo (one-pager) if committee is needed.

Ben
Ben Carter
Deal Desk Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@clearwind.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearwind.io>, procurement@clearwind.io
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discount request — need expedited deal desk + finance review (ClearWind)

Hi Laura / Ben — thanks for the quick response. We are working to close this week; the team prefers a clean, signed SOW rather than milestone rebates if possible. Key notes from our side:
- Legal has asked to keep the initial term 12 months with a discount applied to the full first-year value.
- We can accept a staged commercial escalation (e.g., extension of volume commitments in year 2) but prefer the first-year discount to be explicit.

I can push for flexibility on the legal term, but commercial wants the 28% to be final in the SOW. If you can provide a deal memo or an interim approval note from pricing that allows us to move to signature, procurement will accept.

Can we get a one-page approval memo that states: approved discount %, approver names, and any post-signature constraints? If you can deliver that today, we can execute the SOW and keep the commit.

Thanks — Samantha
Procurement Manager
ClearWind Energy

Thanks everyone — quick operational note to preserve forecast accuracy:
1) Ben: please confirm whether you can issue an interim approval memo for procurement (one page) that authorizes execution contingent on formal pricing committee review next Tuesday. Memo should include: approved interim discount (max 20%), signatory from Deal Desk, and a clear note that final >20% requires pricing committee + finance sign-off. Due EOD today if possible.
2) Karthik / Sales: mark HubSpot stage for CW-9843 as "Commit (pending pricing committee)" so our forecast model treats this as a commit with a probability adjustment of +0.25 until committee outcome is final. Include the Deal Desk memo in the record link.
3) Vanessa / Finance Ops: run a quick sensitivity for Q4 that assumes both outcomes (20% approved vs 28% approved) and attach to the forecast workbook. We need a delta to present at pipeline triage on Wednesday.
4) Markus: if you can provide a brief note on whether we can permit a one-time exception for 28% in this strategic account, please advise. If not, confirm committee timing is acceptable.

I will notify ClearWind that we can provide an interim memo to unblock their procurement with the expectation of final committee review. If we cannot produce the interim memo, please flag here and I will escalate to CRO.

Deadline: EOD today for the memo and HubSpot stage update.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, GTM Finance
Redwood Inference
